Different harvesting methods also have varying impacts; some methods may be more prone to bycatch of other species, while others may disturb the seafloor.

From a resource management perspective, ensuring the long-term health of the krill population is vital not only for the marine ecosystem but also for the continued availability of omega-3 supplements.
